title: The Canon of Azure Vitality
summary: A canon of the Azure Sky healers on pouring a great tide of renewal over every wounded ally within sight.

title: Treatise of the Twin Springs of Life
summary: A treatise on two streams of life that cleanse the cursed and recall the fallen and veil the living from poison.

title: The Physicians' Archive of Revival
summary: A record of how the Azure physicians recall the stricken and drain the strength of a foe to feed a healer's own wounds.

title: Manual of the Sky-Court Healers
summary: A manual of the graceful healers of the Azure court who flow from mending to warding to rousing strike without pause.

title: The Sapphire Renewal Treatise
summary: A treatise on quiet salves and wide lingering warmth that ends with a veil which quells poison and curse alike.

title: Canon of the Unbroken Heartbeat
summary: A canon of the heartbeat that is kept from stopping and called back when it does and turned into a bursting blow.

title: The Oath-Wind Vitality Canon
summary: A canon of the Gale healers who swear to leave no comrade behind and recall the fallen with an oath-bound surge.

title: Treatise of the Plateau Physicians
summary: A treatise on long days of hard tending that gives the healer anvil-heavy strikes and a clamp that saps an enemy.

title: The Gale-Breath Book of Recall
summary: A book on breath that treats the lungs and clears the dust and brings a comrade back with a single rescuing surge.

title: Manual of the Wind-Washed Wound
summary: A manual for wounds left open to the weather that wraps and purges them and ends in a needling renewal.

title: The Long Gale Renewal Compendium
summary: A compendium of layered closings and double purges that whirls through a long rite and calls back the lifeless.

title: Canon of the Open Sky Pulse
summary: A canon of the pulse that runs out under the open sky and mends the lines of a whole company at once.
